# E0628: a generated file on disk is not what would be generated

With --check, a command that generates files writes nothing, and checks the
files already on disk instead: here `thema lineage gen gotypes`, whose files
for version 0.0 are out of date, and for version 0.1 were never generated. One
diagnostic names each file; running the command without --check regenerates
them.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				name: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				name:  string
				crew?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: "0.1->0.0": {
	v0_1: _
	v0_0: name: v0_1.name
}
```

`gen/v0_0/types.go`:

```
// Code generated by thema. DO NOT EDIT.

package v0_0

// Ship is version 0.0 of the ship lineage's schema.
type Ship struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0628]: a generated file on disk is what would be generated, and gen/v0_0/types.go differs
  |
  = help: run the command without --check to regenerate it

error[E0628]: a generated file is on disk, and gen/v0_1/types.go is missing
  |
  = help: run the command without --check to regenerate it
```
